explication: ESPectre is an on-device Wi-Fi motion-sensing platform with C++ and MicroPython runtimes, several firmware frontends, and host-side device and research tools. Its main workflow captures Wi-Fi CSI, evaluates motion locally, then exposes occupancy and diagnostics through a chosen integration. The graph preserves the documented firmware paths and research capabilities. Several subsystem links are supported by the README rather than sampled implementation; unsampled wiring is not inferred.
